entries.title: Proverbs 1:1
segments: ¶The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:2
segments: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:3
segments: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity; {equity: Heb. equities}

entries.title: Proverbs 1:4
segments: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion. {discretion: or, advisement}

entries.title: Proverbs 1:5
segments: A wise [man] will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:6
segments: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings. {the interpretation: or, an eloquent speech}

entries.title: Proverbs 1:7
segments: ¶The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of knowledge: [but] fools despise wisdom and instruction. {the beginning: or, the principal part}

entries.title: Proverbs 1:8
segments: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:9
segments: For they [shall be] an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck. {an...: Heb. an adding}

entries.title: Proverbs 1:10
segments: ¶My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:11
segments: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:

words.text: with us, let us lay wait

entries.title: Proverbs 1:12
segments: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:13
segments: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:14
segments: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:

words.text: us; let us all have one

entries.title: Proverbs 1:15
segments: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:16
segments: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:17
segments: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird. {in the...: Heb. in the eyes of every thing that hath a wing}

words.text: . {in the...: Heb. in the eyes of every thing that hath a wing}

entries.title: Proverbs 1:18
segments: And they lay wait for their [own] blood; they lurk privily for their [own] lives.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:19
segments: So [are] the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; [which] taketh away the life of the owners thereof.

words.text: of every one that is greedy

entries.title: Proverbs 1:20
segments: ¶Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets: {Wisdom: Heb. Wisdoms, that is, Excellent wisdom}

words.text: : {Wisdom: Heb. Wisdoms, that is, Excellent wisdom}

entries.title: Proverbs 1:21
segments: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, [saying],

entries.title: Proverbs 1:22
segments: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?

entries.title: Proverbs 1:23
segments: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.

words.text: unto you, I will make known

entries.title: Proverbs 1:24
segments: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:25
segments: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:

words.text: But ye have set at nought

entries.title: Proverbs 1:26
segments: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:27
segments: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:28
segments: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:

words.text: upon me, but I will not answer

entries.title: Proverbs 1:29
segments: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:30
segments: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:31
segments: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:32
segments: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them. {turning...: or, ease of the simple}

words.text: them. {turning...: or, ease of the simple}

entries.title: Proverbs 1:33
segments: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
